item.title: Gainesville · 2026-10-01 · City Commission Meeting (City Commission Meeting): City Auditor Annual Report (B)
item.description: The Office of the city auditor must conform to both Global Internal Audit Standards from the Institute of Internal Auditors and Generally Acceptable Government Auditing Standards from the US Government Accountability Office. Both standards require the Office of the City Auditor to communicate results of its work to governance. The city auditor’s Annual Report is presented to comply with this requirement.

item.title: Gainesville · 2026-10-01 · City Commission Meeting (City Commission Meeting): City Auditor Strategic Plan (B)
item.description: The Institute of Internal Auditors, through its Global Internal Audit Standards, requires an internal audit department to develop a strategic plan. The city auditor’s strategic plan aligns with the City's strategic objectives.

item.title: Gainesville · 2026-10-01 · City Commission Meeting (City Commission Meeting): FY 2027 Annual Audit Plan (B)
item.description: Every year, the Office of the City Auditor works with the City’s executive management both to update the audit universe and develop a risk-based audit plan. This citywide risk assessment process considers various risk factors, among them financial impact, public interest, regulatory requirements, technology changes, and other factors. The plan proposes assurance engagements that the Office of the City Auditor will conduct in FY 2027, aligning audit resources with areas of greatest risk.

item.title: Gainesville · 2026-10-01 · City Commission Meeting (City Commission Meeting): Workday General and Application Controls (B)
item.description: The Office of the City Auditor conducted an information technology audit of Workday, the City’s enterprise resource planning system. The objective of the audit was to assess whether the user access process for the system utilizes standard and secure IT practices, including access on a need-to-know basis, across the entire employee lifecycle.

item.title: Gainesville · 2026-10-01 · City Commission Meeting (City Commission Meeting): Community Resource Paramedicine (B)​
item.description: The Office of the City Auditor conducted an audit of the Community Resource Paramedicine program in the Fire Rescue Department. The objective of the audit was to evaluate the effectiveness of the Community Resource Paramedicine program in achieving its intended community health objectives and assess its compliance with regulations.

item.title: Gainesville · 2026-10-01 · City Commission Meeting (City Commission Meeting): Appointments to the City Beautification Board (B)
item.description: The mission of the City Beautification Board is to elevate the quality of life for the residents of Gainesville by enhancing the urban environment. The Board's focus has been to address the community's environmental and aesthetic concerns by promoting stewardship, improvement, and maintenance of community assets; coordinated planning and supportive beautification programs; excellence in design; and opportunities for general public participation in beautification endeavors through gifts, grants, bequests, and other contributions for beautification.
